post.text:
#SDF commander threatens to wipe out Arab tribes if they rise up & side with #Syria’s government:

“Warning to the Tribes in #Qamishli:

Any move against our people, we will erase you entirely from history.

The message is to everyone, not just #Qamishli!
#YPG” https://t.co/tPlALIMsjl
post.author_description:
Director of #Syria Program, @MiddleEastInst.
Founder https://t.co/QX1KDP0vBO.
Senior Consultant, @KShaar_Advisory.
